text:
eli.sales: Acme signed off on the POC timeline. They asked for a clear key lifecycle doc: creation, rotation cadence (they prefer weekly), and immediate revocation procedure. Need to hand this to their security contact today.

sam.se: We should avoid weekly auto-rotation for a POC unless they can pull keys from our Secrets Manager. For the POC we can issue a 7-day scoped key and show a documented manual rotation flow.

eli.sales: Theyre using GitHub Actions and local dev. CI needs minimal friction.

tori.eng: Plan I propose:
1) Issue a scoped hosted API key with TTL=168h (7d). Scope limited to generation+embeddings, no admin scopes.
2) Store the secret in Redwood Secrets Manager at secret://acme/poc/api_key_current and give Acme read access via a short-lived integration token if they want to pull it in CI.
3) Enable audit logging and set retention to 90 days (security asked for proof of call logs).
4) Schedule a 48h and 12h expiry webhook reminder to CS.
5) Provide explicit CLI and Console revoke steps and a sample rotation checklist.

naha.cs: Add to the security questionnaire that key rotation for the POC will be manual (create new key, update secret, smoke test, revoke old), and include sample commands. That should satisfy them.

tori.eng: Revoke CLI (admin-only):
```bash
# revoke by key id
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/admin/keys/revoke \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_API_TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"key_id\":\"tok-poc-acme-1777\"}'
```
Console: Console > Admin > API Keys > filter \"project:acme-poc\" > Revoke. Revocation is immediate and returns 401 for new requests.

tori.eng: Create key CLI (admin):
```bash
# create a new scoped key (returns secret)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/admin/keys/create \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_API_TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"name\":\"acme-poc-week1\",\"scopes\":[\"generate\",\"embeddings\"],\"ttl_hours\":168,\"tags\":{\"owner\":\"eli.sales\",\"type\":\"poc\",\"project\":\"acme-poc\"}}'
```
Note: the response contains the secret value once. We store it in Secrets Manager immediately.

sam.se: Rotation checklist to hand to Acme (manual flow):
- Admin: create new key (see create above)
- Ops: update secret at secret://acme/poc/api_key_current (or update GH Actions secret)
- Dev: run smoke test against /v1/generate to confirm new key works
- Admin: revoke old key id (see revoke above)

eli.sales: Provide a tiny GH Actions update snippet so they can swap keys with minimal downtime.

tori.eng: GH Actions replacement example:
```yaml
- name: Update API key secret
  uses: actions/checkout@v3
- name: Set Redwood key
  run: |
    echo "REDSWOOD_KEY=$(curl -sS https://secrets.redwood.com/v1/get?path=acme/poc/api_key_current -H \"Authorization: Bearer $INTEGRATION_TOKEN\")" >> $GITHUB_ENV
```
(We will provide a managed integration token if they want CI pull access; otherwise they can paste the secret into GH repo secrets.)

naha.cs: For the security questionnaire, include: audit log retention=90d, owner contact=eli.sales@redwood.com, token metadata tags set to owner/project/type, and explicit revocation timeframe (immediate on request).

eli.sales: Can we allow overlapping keys during rollout? They wanted zero downtime while swapping.

tori.eng: Yes: two keys can be valid concurrently. Create new key, update config, smoke test, then revoke old key. Document the expected 401 behavior: any request with revoked key returns 401 immediately; logs will show attempts.

sam.se: If Acme asks for weekly automated rotation, we can enable a rotation job but recommend they adopt the Secrets Manager pull pattern for GH Actions to avoid manual repo secret updates. Auto-rotation for POC is heavy-handed.

ops-bot: Created key tok-poc-acme-1777, scope=[generate,embeddings], ttl=168h, owner=eli.sales, secret=secret://acme/poc/api_key_current. Audit logging enabled, retention=90d. 48h and 12h reminders scheduled.

eli.sales: Thanks  I'll include the create/revoke snippets, GH Actions example, and the rotation checklist in the onboarding email to Acme. Please tag the key with poc=true and set owner email in metadata.

tori.eng: Done: tags poc=true, owner=eli.sales@redwood.com, project=acme-poc. If security insists on IP allowlist we can request eng-ops to apply a scoped allowlist but that may add ~24h lead time.

naha.cs: I'll update the security questionnaire answers and attach a screenshot of Console > Admin > Audit showing the new key creation entry.

eli.sales: Great  closing thread. If Acme requests automated rotation mid-POC, reopen and we'll configure the rotation job and CI integration.

ops-bot: Audit record: action=key.create, key_id=tok-poc-acme-1777, actor=tori.eng, ts=1777778337.
